QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults off ... by default, nothing inside the library runs concurrently and no mutex is taken." and "The library itself spawns nothing."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads by default, but it lists the pthread example as a thread-spawning site and never says that it compiles to a stub main under a default build.
